facts.value: Resolves Fighter from gobj and copies the complete ftNessAttributes value from fp->ft_data->ext_attr into storage already addressed by fp->dat_attrs. COPY_ATTRS does not assign dat_attrs or select dat_attrs_backup; valid typed source and destination storage are required.
facts.rationale: Canonical macro expansion contradicts baseline pointer activation/restoration.

evidence.why: Copies through existing active pointer without assigning it.

facts.value: Refreshes Ness's existing active character-attribute storage from external ftNessAttributes; unlike OnLoad's PUSH_ATTRS operation, it does not install or redirect the active pointer.

Centralizes yo-yo, PK Flash, PK Thunder and bat cleanup in that order. Successful bat and PK Flash creation install it as both take_dmg_cb and death2_cb. Callees guard stored article references; Thunder effect/graphics cleanup is limited to its nine SpecialHi-family states, while its interruption callbacks and part-0 X rotation are reset on all paths. This does not guarantee complete removal of all move callbacks or effects.
facts.rationale: Repairs absolute teardown claim and records verified secondary-death use.

evidence.why: Conditional effects and unconditional fallthrough resets.
Both callback slots installed on success.
Yo-yo cleanup and additional callbacks distinguish limited teardown.

facts.value: Delegates with both fixed options true. Heavy held items skip all common-inline updates. Otherwise hold kinds 1,2,3,4 select ftAnim_80070FB4 arguments 1,0,2,3; other kinds skip that call. A true catchItemFlag then independently invokes ftAnim_80070C48(gobj,true) within the non-heavy branch. Numeric hold kinds are not assigned gameplay categories.
facts.rationale: Records exact optional branches and default behavior.

evidence.why: Heavy-item guard, switch and catch branch.

facts.value: Through the shared inline always calls ftAnim_80070FB4(gobj,true,-1), then calls ftAnim_80070CC4(gobj,true) only when dropItemFlag is true. Unlike pickup and visibility handling, this path has no heavy-item guard.
facts.rationale: Documents exact sentinel and optional branch without invented option meanings.

evidence.why: Unconditional reset and conditional second call.

facts.value: Returns active x94_PSI_MAGNET_HEAL_MUL unchanged, without validation, clamping or hard-coded default. The absorption consumer casts absorbed damage times this value to int before subtracting it from percent. Finite representable products truncate toward zero; zero/sub-unit products can yield zero recovery and negative products can increase percent. No portable result is asserted for NaN, infinity or out-of-range integer conversions.
facts.rationale: Makes numeric limits explicit without claiming a default multiplier.

evidence.why: Conversion, subtraction, lower clamp and credited-healing adjustment.
